A Two\+Cmplt struct contains the value (called value, an Int) of the two\textquotesingle{}s complement variable, and properties defining the variable. These properties describe the number of bits used for the variable (nbits, an Int), whether the variable is considered to be signed or unsigned (signed, a Bool), and the precision if it\textquotesingle{}s not zero (prec, an Int). The precision determines how the value should be scaled when it is combined with other two\textquotesingle{}s complement integers similar to how Matlab represents two\textquotesingle{}s complement variables using it\textquotesingle{}s "{}fi"{} objects.
